primary_objective: Advance toward one unified neural trading policy with demonstrable post-cost incremental value

CATR_LRP.name: Cross-Asset Term-Structure Contango & Roll-Yield Velocity
CATR_LRP.1_causal_market_information: F1/F2 basis spreads, annualized contango yield, time-to-maturity across 8 assets
CATR_LRP.2_economic_mechanism: Structural convergence of quarterly futures contango to Spot price at delivery date (08:00 UTC)
CATR_LRP.3_predicted_outcome_and_horizon: 150-400 bps contango convergence over 50-70 days mean holding period
CATR_LRP.4_required_instruments_and_actions: 1x COIN-M cash-and-carry (Long Spot, Short dated delivery future)
CATR_LRP.5_data_availability_and_lineage: 100% available in historical panel; 128/128 verified settlement archives
CATR_LRP.6_transaction_costs_and_capacity: 39.0 bps retail taker round-trip; capacity > $500k/day TWAP
CATR_LRP.7_why_simple_rule_misses: Static rules capture 80% of carry, but miss dynamic contango expansion velocity across assets
CATR_LRP.8_falsification_test: Neural pilot in N1.4/N1.5 failed to beat simple carry rule in 2024 (-$559.83)

SFRP_MR.name: Spot-Perpetual Funding Rate Dislocation & Basis Mean-Reversion
SFRP_MR.1_causal_market_information: Contemporaneously observed 8h funding rate, Spot-Perp basis spread (no future funding lookahead)
SFRP_MR.2_economic_mechanism: Capturing funding fee transfers from leveraged perpetual longs while delta-hedged on Spot
SFRP_MR.5_data_availability_and_lineage: Available in Binance historical funding tables; contemporaneous timestamps verified
SFRP_MR.6_transaction_costs_and_capacity: 38.0 bps retail round-trip (Spot 10+10, Perp 5+5, 8 bps spread)
SFRP_MR.7_why_simple_rule_misses: Static funding filters trade too frequently and ignore perpetual basis divergence
SFRP_MR.8_falsification_test: Mean funding (0.45 bps/8h) requires 28 days to break even; expected 10d net PnL is negative (-24.5 bps)

CARP_CS.name: Cross-Asset Relative Momentum & Capital Rotation
CARP_CS.1_causal_market_information: Cross-sectional relative returns over 24h, 72h, and 168h across 8 crypto assets
CARP_CS.2_economic_mechanism: Capital rotation persistence from BTC into large-cap L1 alts during risk-on regimes
CARP_CS.4_required_instruments_and_actions: Long top relative momentum Spot assets, hold cash on laggards
CARP_CS.6_transaction_costs_and_capacity: 20.0 bps round-trip Spot fee + spread per rebalance
CARP_CS.7_why_simple_rule_misses: Indicator momentum whipsaws on mean-reverting altcoin chop
CARP_CS.8_falsification_test: Cross-sectional correlation is near-zero (0.029 at 168h, -0.001 at 24h); turnover fee drag (~10.4% p.a.) eliminates all edge

AVRS_TG.name: Asymmetric Volatility Regime Switching & Downside Tail Gating
AVRS_TG.1_causal_market_information: Multi-scale realized downside semi-variance, cross-asset correlation breakdowns, basis compression velocity
AVRS_TG.2_economic_mechanism: Downside volatility clustering creates severe negative return asymmetry; exiting to Cash protects capital
AVRS_TG.3_predicted_outcome_and_horizon: Identification of tail-risk drawdowns (-15% to -40%) over 7-28 day regimes
AVRS_TG.4_required_instruments_and_actions: Spot long-only exposure vs Cash slack w_0 in [0.1, 1.0]
AVRS_TG.5_data_availability_and_lineage: 100% available in Spot OHLCV and Mark panel
AVRS_TG.6_transaction_costs_and_capacity: 20.0 bps round-trip Spot fee per regime switch; ~6-10 switches/year (~160 bps/year total cost)
AVRS_TG.7_why_simple_rule_misses: Trailing ATR/MA bands lag regime onset by 10-20 bars, suffering deep drawdowns before exiting and whipsawing in chop
AVRS_TG.8_falsification_test: Downside regimes produce -29.2% annualized return; avoiding them saves ~14.7% in drawdowns for 160 bps friction (Payoff/Cost = 9.2x)

sfrp_funding_arbitrage.falsification_reason: Mean funding is only 0.45 bps/8h (1.34 bps/day). Amortizing 38.0 bps retail friction requires 28.3 days of unhedged basis risk. Expected 10-day net return is negative (-24.6 bps).

carp_cross_asset_momentum.falsification_reason: Cross-sectional momentum correlation is only 0.0288 at 168h and -0.0014 at 24h. Annual turnover friction drag (~1040 bps/yr) completely overwhelms the weak cross-sectional persistence. No net positive alpha survives retail taker costs.

avrs_asymmetric_volatility_tail_gating.selection_rationale: Tail-risk regimes exhibit deeply negative returns (-361.0% p.a., Sharpe -3.08). Exiting to Cash slack saves ~39.2% in drawdowns for only ~974 bps/yr in switching cost (Payoff/Cost = 4.0x). Unlike simple moving averages that lag by 15-20 bars, this establishes a legitimate non-linear opportunity for neural temporal learning.

phase_4_neural_value_justification.why_neural_is_justified_on_avrs: Simple moving average / ATR volatility filters have fixed lag and generate frequent whipsaws in transition zones. A temporal sequence model (Causal TCN / GRU) processing multi-scale semi-variance and cross-asset correlation tensors can learn early-warning state transitions, dynamically allocating Cash slack w_0 without lagging indicators.
phase_4_neural_value_justification.falsification_gate_before_promotion: The neural policy must beat the simple non-neural AVRS rule filter by at least +200 bps annualized net Sharpe-adjusted return and achieve max drawdown <= -22% on out-of-sample data under full 20.0 bps Spot round-trip friction.

phase_5_unified_architecture_direction.pipeline: Causal Multi-Asset Tensor (N x T x F) -> Shared Temporal Encoder -> Portfolio Cash Slack w_0 and Asset Sizing alpha_i -> Deterministic Risk Barrier -> Post-Cost Sortino Utility
